title: gitnft
tagline: A personalized Github NFT for your resume. Just type your github username and we provide you with your personalised NFT. to prepare you for different job profiles.
description:
A lot of Web3 Projects cloned towards web2 projects but we wanted to make full use of web3 ideas and came up with the idea Gitnft where we provide the user's personalized fun GitHub nft through various off-chain APIs. After coming to our platform user just have to enter their username and respectively their canvas is generated and they can easily mint their NFT and show it off to the world!

The aim of this project is to provide a fun way to interact that can be useful for the beginner in web3 and they can utilise our Dapp to be familiar with Web3 Space.

There is our extended version of our project that deals with making Cards for job profiles through github that can be useful for various stakeholders for various recruitment process.
